# `account_audit`

Area: **security** ([all tables](README.md))

Append-only log of agent actions on accounts: who, what, when, whether it was done or refused and how the customer was verified. No foreign keys: the log outlives what it describes. Never holds a PIN.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `seq` | `bigint` | no |  | Insertion order: the tie-break when two rows share a time. |
| `at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `operator` | `text` | no |  | The signed-in user, the MCP principal, or carrier for a carrier request. |
| `role` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `customer_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `action` | `text` | no |  | sim_swap, number_change, number_transfer_pin, contact_change, port_out, pin_set, pin_reset, lock_set, lock_cleared, pin_lockout, and the care work of issue 199: interaction_logged, ticket_opened, ticket_status_changed, care_note_added, and self-care of issue 195: care_sign_in, care_locked, care_password_changed. |
| `outcome` | `text` | no |  | done, or refused (see reason). |
| `reason` | `text` | yes |  | Why it was refused (pinRequired, pinInvalid, pinNotSet, pinLocked, simSwapLocked, portOutLocked) or the reason the agent gave for a PIN or lock change. |
| `verification` | `text` | no |  | pin (a valid PIN was sent), notRequired (the switch is off), none (no PIN was needed or sent); for self-care password+code (a sign-in) or code (a password set with an emailed link code). |
| `detail` | `jsonb` | no | `'{}'::jsonb` | What the action touched (order, SIM, number, fields changed; the interaction or ticket of a care entry), and for a contact change the addresses the alert goes to. No secrets. |

| `account_audit_verification_check` | check | `CHECK ((verification = ANY (ARRAY['pin'::text, 'notRequired'::text, 'none'::text, 'password+code'::text, 'code'::text])))` |
| `account_audit_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
